name: ES3C28P (KryonDeck local emu target)

display.notes: SPI live display via external cosim host; routing/model gaps observed in esp-emu tests (matrix: needs-runtime-host).

touch_input.notes: I2C regfile/init-poll supported with board-es3c28p.json; full interaction depends on model/part.

audio.notes: I2S WAV out/in by file supported; realtime PCM/codec full path conditional. ESP_EMU_SKIP_AUDIO skips audio/SD/ADC init in es3c28p_emu build.

storage.flash_fs: LittleFS/spiffs partition (merge may include FS @0xc90000 per layout)
storage.sd_emulation: supported-now (esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd, ESP32-S3 SDMMC; verified with a card image)
storage.notes: simulator/SD_Card (~37MB) > spiffs 3.36MB; not directly mappable. esp-emu 1.1.0 mounts a card image with --sd; the es3c28p_emu build runs the same initSD() (not gated by ESP_EMU_SKIP_AUDIO).

local.notes: Local emu build; es3c28p (hw) env also exists.

kryonos_v3.notes: No KryonOS v3.0.0 release asset for es3c28p in prep matrix; use local/asset flows.

asset_es3c28p.notes: Optional asset ELF if present alongside asset.

notes: Boot serial/headless supported for es3c28p_emu build (ESP_EMU_SKIP_AUDIO).
Host SDL pins/resolution largely compiled in panel_config.h; runtime overrides partial.
SDMMC via esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd (card image from ./start.sh card image).
